comment: Tables in core/module_* schemas that DELIBERATELY lack some service_role DML. Each entry MUST have a justification. `missing` lists the verbs intentionally withheld — an offender passes only if every verb it lacks is listed here, so losing an unrelated grant still fails the check. Omit `missing` to allow any. The guard is scripts/check-grants-coverage.mjs. Note that service_role bypasses RLS, so a missing grant makes a table unreachable for the API — it is not a security control, it is append-only enforcement at best.
